title: Request for change time setting cloud upload
body:
Hi,

Is it possible to change the way of setting the time by "Cloud Upload" to TidePool.
Now (with the slider) it is almost impossible to set the time on 720 minutes (12 hour).
Just a txt box would be great.

Jerry
